needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader restricts a 'spell_or_ability' target's selector to 'controller' only (loader.targets._compile_target), and no selector_keys entry reads a stack object's own targets; 'counter' with target t1 can only counter any spell or ability, which is strictly wider than the printing

needs.what: a cost_reduction 'targeting' gate that can look through a stack-object target to its targets: {amount: 7} if the chosen spell-or-ability target itself targets a creature you control with power 7 or greater
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction 'targeting' filters the cast's object targets with cost_reduction_filter_keys (types, controller, power...) but a stack-object target has no such characteristics and there is no key to reach the objects that stack object targets
